company.name: Xpence
company.shortDescription: Xpence is the MENAP region's first smart business spend platform for freelancers, startups, SMEs, and corporates.
company.description:
Xpence is the next generation smart business spend platform for MENAP businesses. Xpence empowers businesses with physical and virtual Visa payment cards to effortlessly manage their daily expenses.  

Xpence empowers businesses to take control of their spending. Employers can instantly issue physical and virtual prepaid Visa cards to their employees. They can set spending limits and rules for each card and track all company spending in real-time. Each time an employee uses their card, they're immediately reminded to capture the receipt by push notification. This means that with Xpence, companies can finally stop wasting time doing expense reports.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,295,000 to $13,866,815, a 2.2x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 45 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 35 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
